events.title: Tentacle Nurse Release Schedule
events.summary: Hello everybody!It’s time to share the release plans for Tentacle Nurse.Today, October 16 = The demo goes live!The game is joining Steam Next Fest.November 6 = Full game launch.I hope all of you have a great time with the full release, and thank you for the support!Wishlist the game, jump into the demo, and get ready for the full release!
